snippet.title: FEE3 2024: The Dark Amulet by Vorgus
snippet.description:
The Dark Amulet is a 25-chapter hack of FE8. It provides some minor expansions to vanilla gameplay, while focusing on a fun plot full of twists and turns, fully fleshed out characters (with fully complete supports!), and polished dialogue / writing throughout.

The Dark Amulet is not made for iron man runs. Due to the plot relevancy of many characters, nearly half of the party of heroes cause game over upon death. 

https://feuniverse.us/t/fe8-complete-the-dark-amulet-v1-5-06-14-2024/24299/326
